outcome: subcortical segmental volumes (thalami, caudate nuclei, putamens, pallidums, hippocampi, amygdalae, nuclei accumbens)
cohort: This study included preterm singleton infants (n=59) born between 22 0/7 and 33 6/7 gestational weeks at Nagoya University Hospital between 2014-2020, with 46 exposed to ACS and 13 not exposed.
finding: Antenatal corticosteroids were associated with significantly smaller volumes in the bilateral amygdalae and caudate nuclei at term-equivalent age, an association observed exclusively in infants born at 28 weeks of gestation or later.
